abstract: Project-aware Devin CLI hook scaffolder that verifies the live official Devin hook docs, audits a target repository in detail, and then creates a deterministic bash-first .devin/hooks.v1.json scaffold with shared hooks/ event scripts, Devin adapters per documented lifecycle event, exit-code-2 blocking gates, repeatable merges, reusable repo-owned script delegation, and a shared hooks README for the target project.
